profile.name: 电动旋转夹爪
profile.description: 一种用于机器人末端执行的电动夹爪，具备夹持开合与旋转两个自由度，可设置夹持位置、速度、夹持力以及旋转角度。该设备常用于实验室自动化中的样品抓取、上下料、工件搬运和定位操作。
profile.description_en: An electric robotic gripper with both gripping and rotational motion, allowing control of grip position, speed, gripping force, and rotation angle. It is commonly used in laboratory automation for sample handling, loading and unloading, part transfer, and positioning tasks.

registry.name: Robotic Gripper
registry.description: Robotic Gripper驱动，支持cal crc/read uart/write uart/init state/set force等20个操作。
